# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus v0.6.12

**PC PLUS+ on the title screen, and online leaderboards from the start.** This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## What's new

- **PC PLUS+ on the title screen.** The main menu's logo now says PC PLUS+ under GEOMETRY, in the logo's own lettering and colours, glowing with the rest of it. It's added to your own copy of the logo when the game starts (`game\logo0_pcplus.tga`); the original `logo0.tga` is never changed, and if your logo isn't the expected one the original simply shows.
- **Online leaderboards are on from the start.** Nothing is sent until you choose a player name, so it's still your choice, just one step shorter. Turn it off any time on the launcher's **Gameplay** page.
- **Choose your player name.** The first time the launcher opens with the game installed, it asks for a player name: **Save** (or Enter) puts you on the online boards and shows your name in the game instead of "User"; **Not now** (or Escape) leaves it. Either way it asks only once, and the Gameplay page changes the name whenever you like.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v0.6.12-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
